title: Constraint-overlay polish (DB-263): offset the overlay LINE label off its own line (keep the fail-rather-than-shrink guarantee), replace the fragile expand_frame_for_overlay SVG string-rewrite with a native overlay_present height in compose_context (close branch), give the page-1 rear-yard title strip a word boundary, and add geometric legend-fit + real-geometry label-collision tests. No feasibility fact, rule, calculation or label changes; non-overlay frames byte-identical; the benchmark page 1/3 stays byte-identical because no constraint line is established on it today.
objective: Close the four non-blocking advisories left by the M5-T175 constraint-overlay reviews (backlog DB-263), behaviour-identical on every non-overlay drawing and on the current benchmark (which establishes NO constraint line). (A1 visual) In constraint_overlay.py the established LINE label is anchored on the line (screen_points[mid] with the first _label_candidates offset (0,0)), so the white-halo box sits over the drawn line and hides it. Make the FIRST label candidate a perpendicular offset off the line (within the rect), keeping the full grid fallback and the ConstraintOverlayError fit/collision guarantee, so a measurable part of the drawn line stays visible. (A2 code) Delete the fragile post-hoc SVG string rewrite expand_frame_for_overlay (regex on the first two height attrs + magic _FURNITURE_TOP_PT=400.0) and its __all__ entry; compute the real height natively in context_scene.compose_context. Its close branch already derives furn_bottom = max(north_bottom, legend_bottom, CLOSE_FURN_TOP+46.0) where legend_bottom includes the overlay constraint entry (legend_flow(sheet.kinds)) and the not_placed row, then clamps height = min(CLOSE_MAX_H_PT=470.0, furn_bottom+8.0). Add a keyword-only overlay_present: bool = False parameter; when True, drop the clamp (height = furn_bottom+8.0). All other callers (neighbourhood_map.py, block_map.py, and every non-close site_context_plan branch) omit it -> default False -> byte-identical. In site_context_plan.py close branch pass overlay_present=bool(constraint_lines) to the close compose_context and remove the expand_frame_for_overlay import and its line-734 call. (A3 code) page_decision_summary.py:312 strips the row title with text.startswith(row['title']) and no word boundary; strip only when the char after the title is ':' , whitespace, or end-of-string, preserving the existing 'Rear yard Rear yard' outcome (the char after the title there is a space -> boundary -> still stripped). (A4 QA) Add a geometric legend-fit assertion (the 'No building placed' legend row bottom sits within the composed SVG frame height, measured on an overlay close frame) and a REAL-geometry label-beside-line/collision assertion (not a monkeypatch) using an established-line case. Evidence: see commands (real print proves byte-identity on the benchmark; a constructed established-line close frame is the visual-G3 artifact).
business_reason: Backlog DB-263: four non-blocking advisories from the M5-T175 constraint-overlay reviews. Close them before M5-T173 later takes ownership of constraint_overlay.py and before any document establishes a constraint line that would be drawn with the label hidden / legend clipped (e.g. M5-T170's constructed street-wall case, S6). A2 also removes a fragile string-rewrite the backlog flagged. No legal reading changes.

acceptance_scenarios.given: an overlay close frame with an established rear_yard_100ft_line (the synthetic_rear_yard_constraints_contract_1_5_0 fixture, or an inline established line passed to draw_site_context_plan frame='close')
acceptance_scenarios.then: a measurable portion of the drawn polyline lies OUTSIDE every placed label box (the line is visible). Mutation: revert the perpendicular first candidate to (0,0) -> the label box covers the line anchor and the test fails

acceptance_scenarios.given: a cramped rect where no label fits at >= 8.5 pt
acceptance_scenarios.when: the overlay runs with the new first candidate
acceptance_scenarios.then: ConstraintOverlayError is still raised and no two label boxes overlap; the fit/collision guarantee (S6 of M5-T175) is intact because the full _label_candidates grid fallback is unchanged

acceptance_scenarios.given: the close frame rendered WITH an established overlay line (overlay_present True)
acceptance_scenarios.then: the viewBox height is furn_bottom+8.0, > 470.0, and the 'No building placed' legend row's y+height <= the frame height (geometric fit, measured on the SVG, not only the viewBox); expand_frame_for_overlay appears nowhere. Mutation: re-apply the min(CLOSE_MAX_H_PT, ...) clamp on the overlay path -> the legend row is clipped and the fit assertion fails

acceptance_scenarios.given: the close frame rendered WITHOUT an overlay (overlay_present default False) and every other frame (summary, wide, report, sheet, summary_close, neighbourhood_map, block_map)
acceptance_scenarios.then: the non-overlay close viewBox height == 470.00 (verified clamped at bb5c02b9) and every frame is byte-identical to bb5c02b9. Mutation: drop the overlay_present gate (always use furn_bottom+8) -> the non-overlay close height moves off 470 and the byte-identity test fails

acceptance_scenarios.given: the whole services/api tree after the change
acceptance_scenarios.then: it is defined, exported, imported and called NOWHERE (0 hits)

acceptance_scenarios.given: a page-1 rear-yard combined text whose body begins with the row title
acceptance_scenarios.when: the title is a bare prefix of a LONGER word (boundary probe) vs followed by ':' / whitespace / end
acceptance_scenarios.then: the bare-prefix case is NOT stripped; the ':' / space / end case IS stripped. Mutation: revert to plain startswith -> the bare-prefix probe is mis-stripped and the test fails

acceptance_scenarios.given: the benchmark 1.5.0 document on page 1 (existing S16 behaviour)
acceptance_scenarios.then: 'Rear yard Rear yard' is absent and the conditional no-rear-yard reading (ZR 23-344) still shows; this preserved behaviour is asserted in test_report_page_one.py (DB-263's own file), NOT by editing test_constraint_rows.py

The real print (S8) proves byte-identity (no regression); the beside-line/legend-fit proof (S1/S3/S9) MUST use a constructed established-line case or the synthetic_rear_yard fixture. Do not claim a benchmark before/after.

RISK 2 (latent plain-frame clip, out of scope): the non-overlay close frame is ALREADY clamped at 470 (furn_bottom+8 > 470 verified), so a latent clip may exist there. DB-263 must NOT widen the plain frame; overlay_present=False preserves 470 exactly. S4 is the red/green guard.

RISK 3 (A3 consumer not in scope): the existing S16 'Rear yard Rear yard' assertion lives in test_constraint_rows.py (M5-T170's file), which DB-263 cannot edit. A3 is behaviour-identical on the existing data, so that test stays green; DB-263 MUST run test_constraint_rows.py and test_report_pages.py as read-only consumer checks and route any needed change to the orchestrator, never edit them.

RISK 4 (public symbol removal): expand_frame_for_overlay is in constraint_overlay.py __all__ (public) with exactly one consumer (site_context_plan.py) and no test. Removal is safe; the producer runs a code-graph impact sweep and records the public-symbol removal in the report.

RISK 5 (signature change): compose_context is also imported by neighbourhood_map.py and block_map.py; a keyword-only overlay_present default keeps both byte-identical (they never pass it and never use the close/overlay path) and they need no edit and stay forbidden.

RISK 6 (modularity): at bb5c02b9 modularity_check --check passes (failures 0). context_scene.py (630 lines) is NOT flagged; its ~3-line growth is safe. site_context_plan.py (745) is at WARN but DB-263 shrinks it. constraint_overlay.py shrinks. Run modularity_check --check to confirm no new warning.

RISK 7 (sequencing): DB-263 must land BEFORE M5-T173 (which later owns constraint_overlay.py). It shares NO file with M5-T170 (maps/ and page_decision_summary.py are in M5-T170's forbidden_paths; none of DB-263's files are in M5-T170's allowed_paths), so parallel is file-safe; both exercise page_decision_summary behind test_constraint_rows.py, so the full api pytest must pass in CI at the merged head (R639).
